description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential leave models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectModel" name="Select a leave model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both parties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify company in time"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications complete"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EndOfLeavePeriod" name="End of leave period">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_EndOfLeavePeriod">
        <bpmn:timeDate xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${leavePeriodEnd}</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DecideExtension" name="Decide whether to extend leave"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="No extension chosen"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="UserTask_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_EndOfLeavePeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_EndOfLeavePeriod" targetRef="UserTask_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="UserTask_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extensionRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!extensionRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
